topology.reasoning: The calibrated B&W image contains two disconnected material tracks. Each track enters as a horizontal port, follows a rounded downward/upward S-bend into a long parallel interaction region, and exits through the mirrored bend. The upper track is wider in the central parallel region and the lower track is narrower; both return to approximately the same port width at the four ends. The close central spacing is the coupling gap, and the common parallel length is the transfer/interactions length. There are no junctions, crossings, rings, or extra layers.
topology.function: Power transfers between the two nearby guides through evanescent coupling in the central parallel section. The primary function-defining geometry is the interaction length and gap; the taper length and the two interaction-region widths set the adiabatic/asymmetric coupling profile. Bend radius, port spacing, and straight lead lengths determine routing fidelity and footprint.

knobs.transfer_length: length of the central parallel interaction region
knobs.coupler_gap: edge-to-edge spacing between the interaction-region guides
knobs.taper_length: length over which each guide changes between port and interaction width
knobs.wide_width: upper guide width in the interaction region
knobs.narrow_width: lower guide width in the interaction region
knobs.bend_radius: radius used by the four rounded approach/departure bends

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only assembly with constant port/interaction widths; the visible wide and narrow guides were vertically exchanged by the GDS-to-image y flip.
Flipped the GDS y placement so the wide guide is visibly upper, extended the S-bends to 17 um, and shortened the local tapers while preserving the 120 um span.
Moved the port-to-interaction taper onto the input side and made the 60 um center an explicit width exchange; this trial omitted the full output lead and measured a 106 um bbox.
Restored the 120 um bbox with a 15 um output lead; retained linear upper-wide/lower-narrow-to-port width exchange across the center.
Replaced the entry bends with a fitted shallow-entry sigmoid S profile, moved the input taper to x=5..15 um, and kept the central exchange widths.
Made the exit bends start at x=87 um with a compact smoothstep profile, carried 0.31/0.29 um widths into the bend-to-port transition, and centered the interaction region at 1.99 um.
